excerpt.en: Voxtral 3 combines transcription, reasoning, tool use, and speech in real time across 50+ languages, but independent validation is still needed.

text.zh: Voxtral 3把语音代理串成实时流程
text.en: Voxtral 3 connects voice agents in real time

text.zh: Voxtral 3是Mistral推出的一组语音模型和语音代理SDK，目标是让系统在实时对话中连续完成听取、理解、调用工具和回答。它面向客服、服务台、虚拟助手和免提副驾驶等场景，重点不只是把语音转成文字，而是处理多步骤任务。示例中，代理能读懂法语转诊信息、查询编号、预约时间，并用英语确认后续安排。
text.en: Voxtral 3 is a family of speech models and a voice agent SDK from Mistral. It is designed to let systems listen, interpret, call tools, and respond within one real-time conversation. The target uses include contact centers, service desks, virtual assistants, and hands-free copilots. The focus is more than speech recognition: the agent is expected to handle multi-step tasks. In the example, it reads a French referral, looks up a reference number, books an appointment, and confirms the next steps in English.

text.zh: 多语言转写与更自然的语音输出
text.en: Multilingual transcription and more natural speech

text.zh: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3支持50多种语言，并包含说话人区分、关键词提示和结束语检测等能力。实时转写版本据称可在35种以上语言中实现低于500毫秒的延迟；Mini TTS 3则覆盖35种以上语言和50多种方言，并根据上下文调整情绪、语速和重音。Mistral还提供专业语音适配，声称使用约30分钟音频即可跨语言复现说话者的声音特征和表达风格。
text.en: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 supports more than 50 languages and includes diarization, keyphrase biasing, and end-of-turn detection. Mistral says its real-time transcription model can deliver sub-500-millisecond latency across more than 35 languages. Mini TTS 3 covers over 35 languages and 50 dialects, adapting emotion, pace, and emphasis to context. For professional use, Mistral also describes a voice adaptation feature that can reproduce a speaker’s vocal character and style across languages from about 30 minutes of audio.

text.zh: Voxtral 3的部署价值与现实边界
text.en: Voxtral 3 deployment value and open questions

text.zh: Voxtral 3可通过Mistral的欧洲托管API使用，也可部署在组织自有基础设施上。这样，企业可以更直接地控制音频处理位置、数据留存和敏感对话的运行环境，这对受监管行业或强调数据主权的团队具有吸引力。上下文关键词还能帮助系统识别专业术语，而不必为每个领域重新微调模型。
text.en: Voxtral 3 is available through Mistral’s EU-hosted API or for self-deployment on an organization’s infrastructure. This gives teams more control over where audio is processed, whether it is retained, and how sensitive conversations are handled, which may matter in regulated or sovereignty-focused environments. Contextual keyphrases can also improve recognition of domain terms without fine-tuning a model for every field.

text.zh: 不过，文中的准确率、延迟、价格和领先表现主要来自Mistral列出的内部或合作方评测，不能直接等同于所有真实场景的效果。电话噪声、口音、多人抢话、错误工具调用，以及语音克隆的授权与滥用风险，仍需要独立测试和产品治理。Voxtral 3的关键问题因此不是功能清单有多长，而是在高风险工作流中能否稳定、可审计地完成任务。
text.en: The reported accuracy, latency, pricing, and leadership claims come primarily from evaluations presented by Mistral or its partners, so they should not be treated as universal real-world results. Independent testing is still needed for phone noise, accents, overlapping speakers, incorrect tool calls, and the consent and abuse risks of voice adaptation. The central question for Voxtral 3 is therefore not how long its feature list is, but whether it can complete high-stakes workflows reliably and with adequate auditability.
